text:
```yaml
name: PR Preview (Artifact + Cloudflare)

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.x'

      - name: Build website
        run: dotnet publish ./website -c Release -o ./publish

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: website-preview
          path: ./publish
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        id: cloudflare
        if: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN != '' && env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID != '' }}
        uses: cloudflare/pages-action@v1
        with:
          account-id: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          project-name: RazorConsole
          api-token: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./publish

      - name: Post preview comment
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          body: |
            ## RazorConsole PR Preview

            ${{ steps.cloudflare.outputs.url && format('**Live preview:** {0}', steps.cloudflare.outputs.url) || '' }}

            **Download the built site:** https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}/artifacts

            *This comment will be updated on subsequent PR changes.*
```
